summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for AI + Music Hub. Backend: 30/30 pytest cases pass covering auth (OTP request/verify/me/profile update, 401 protections), chat (Claude 4.6 send/history/clear, empty rejection), notes AI (from-song via Claude), melody detection (synthetic A4 WAV correctly detected), and public channel (posts CRUD, like toggle, comments, invalid IDs). Frontend: Login (email->OTP flow) works, home renders 2x2 tile grid (4/4 tiles), Chat with AI sends message + Aria replies via Claude, Studio renders 4 tracks + Play all + tempo slider, Notes 'Find song notes' tab returns full AI breakdown (Key/Chords/Melody), Public Channel loads + compose modal opens + posts submit + like buttons render, Settings theme toggle works and dark mode applies, profile name edit modal opens. No react-native red screen, no deprecated packages (expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch) detected. Studio mic recording is expected native-only per problem statement; screen still renders on web.

ui_bugs.issue: On 390x844 viewport when the compose modal opens, the submit button occasionally sits outside the viewport (Playwright reported 'Element is outside of the viewport'); it does scroll into view but the modal content may need max-height/keyboard-avoiding to stay comfortably visible on smaller phones.

issues: Console warns: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated (use boxShadow)
Console warns: props.pointerEvents is deprecated (use style.pointerEvents)
Animated: `useNativeDriver` not supported on web (harmless warning)

action_items: (LOW) Replace deprecated RN Web style props: `shadow*` -> `boxShadow`, and `props.pointerEvents` -> `style.pointerEvents`, to silence dev-console warnings.

(LOW) Verify the compose modal on the Public Channel keeps the 'Post to channel' button inside the viewport on 390x844 (e.g., wrap in KeyboardAvoidingView + ScrollView, or cap modal height). Functionally the button works after scroll-into-view.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly returns public user shape (no _id leak); posts/comments also stripped of _id. Good.
verify-otp deletes OTP even on expiry/attempt-cap — correct.
notes/detect: min recording length gate at sr//4 samples is reasonable; empty-file/short-file both return 400 as tested.
toggle_like uses `$pull`/`$addToSet` idempotently and reflects state correctly.
Consider deleting orphaned comments when a post is deleted (no delete-post endpoint currently exists, so N/A today).
seed_data_creation: Test users are created on-the-fly via seeded OTPs (bcrypt hash of '123456') in Mongo `otps` collection, then verify-otp is called. Each test user is cleaned up (users, chat_messages, note_lookups, posts, comments, otps) via session-scoped teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To seed an OTP for UI login without an email inbox: `python -c` with the pymongo+passlib snippet in /app/backend/tests/conftest.py::_seed_otp_sync (email must be lowercased; server lowercases before Mongo lookup). Backend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (in /app/frontend/.env). Test suite must be invoked with `-o addopts='-n 0'` to override the xdist config in /app/backend/pytest.ini (xdist parallel + shared preview backend was already the intended config; single-worker mode is safe here).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bug fixes required. Two initial test-suite failures were self-inflicted: (1) fixtures used `asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete` which is unreliable in modern Python — switched to sync pymongo; (2) test emails were mixed-case but the server lowercases email before Mongo lookup, so seeded OTPs were unfindable — fixed by lowercasing in the seed helper and in test emails. After both fixes, 30/30 backend tests pass.
